name: Shining Shooting Sphere

stealth.details: (expert) to notice the floor sensor; DC 0 to notice the sphere

disable: DC 21 Thievery check (expert) to disable the sphere from rotating or Dispel Magic (3nd rank; counteract DC 23) to remove the enchantment.
reset: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any creature moving within range of its sensor.
routine: (1 action) A jeweled planet shoots from the sphere, targeting a random creature within 30 feet. The creature takes 2d8+7 bludgeoning damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Orbital Spin
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the sphere, stepping on the floor sensor

---
Effect The sphere rotates and the trap rolls initiative.

text: A gilded armillary sphere spins in place, shooting jeweled stars and planets at intruders.
